title: Certify the minimum product and snapshot grids of the banked native DAG
body:
## Result and scope

The final forward scalar graph of [PR #7674](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7674) needs **odd factor 225 and 12 binary coefficient bits** for every literal product and addition. Its recursive denominator bound gives the sufficient values 2025 and 18. This audit computes the exact minimum and proves sharpness with basis-input witnesses.

| Scalar states | Minimum integer grid | Odd factor | Binary coefficient bits |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Every literal product and addition | 921600 | 225 | 12 |
| Completed snapshots only | 23040 | 45 | 9 |

The product grid is 576 times coarser than the source's sufficient grid. This is an arithmetic precision result, not a speedup or physical memory measurement. The snapshot grid is **insufficient for product work**: literal executions on two named basis inputs stop at nonexact divisions. The proof gives the separate prime-factor lower bounds and retains the exact operation order.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/PROOF.md), [receipt and failure locations](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/RESULT.json), [new arithmetic checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/verify.py), [source inventory](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/PREDECESSOR.json) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/TASK.json). The source graph constructor is reused and authenticated. This is a new coefficient audit, not an independent graph compiler.

**No new kappa**, selected-assumption discharge or supplier admission is claimed. The result concerns arbitrary independent normalized scalar inputs and the pinned rational DAG. Physical Clifford factors, the signed caller, recursive depth, magnitude, final unscalings and a full common-root precision substitution remain separate. All five assumptions and [selected PR #7000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7000) remain unchanged. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19703488) on the arithmetic portion of the source's review request.

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 checks passed on macOS arm64. The checker evaluates all **8533666 coefficient products at each grid**, compares all 7643 snapshots under exact rescaling, and checks all 1501 public endpoint rows. A separate Fraction interpreter evaluates four basis inputs and confirms all six sharpness witnesses. Eight negative controls reject missing prime factors and use of the snapshot grid for products. At the minimum product grid, every literal division is exact.

Metadata, committed bytes, executable modes, source ancestry, the official 25-file export and its integrity check passed. An optimized read-only export replay passed without Git or a usable PATH, with all 26 payload/manifest hashes and modes unchanged. The 15 retained predecessor files match their published Git blobs and SHA-256 values, including the original mixed line endings in a source notice. No external run-time input is used. The new proof and README were rendered with GitHub Markdown and checked.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/banked-native-minimum-grid/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/banked-native-minimum-grid/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/banked-native-minimum-grid
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/banked-native-minimum-grid --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected status markers:

```text
PASS_BANKED_NATIVE_MINIMUM_GRID
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44263446950/job/134662103360) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Predecessor scientific suites, physical native operators, the selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Credit and remaining obligations

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The banked graph and sufficient common-root proof are Ali Romman's [PR #7674](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7674), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/PROOF.md) and [source arithmetic evaluator](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e/research/p104-banked-transfer-pivots/native.py). Its scientific commit is `26b6c469aa6c4aa04322ce25a22150f90e5fb14e`; current head `28b2af322a1fab01b3734365988930920f9dda48` adds the shared CI repair. @SYLforge supplied [PR #7669](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7669); the [original credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/predecessor/source/7669-CREDITS.md) and [source notices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/533cdca9225d1c0af1ae8d3b79cb527f59afaf0f/research/banked-native-minimum-grid/predecessor/NOTICE) are retained unchanged. Gareth Davidson (@bitplane) supplied the prefix-coefficient grid criterion and basis-witness method in [PR #866](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/866), [exact precision proof](https://github.com/bitplane/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5ae580bf68516f1cbe3b2dd3cb646be55170288f/research/dyadic-fractional-grid/README.md). The method and source construction are prior work; this contribution binds the sharp product and snapshot grids to the new final graph. New work is Apache-2.0.

A complete physical substitution must keep the caller's separate scale and check the Clifford, unfinished-depth and final-unscaling contributions. No smaller selected root format is asserted here. A different arithmetic lowering could change the temporary grid. Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8; card `supplier-boundary-audit` narrowed to this finite obligation. Open/closed PR and Discussion overlap was checked; sparse local notes and unpublished work remain coverage limits. No source PR or selected artifact is edited.
